Package com.csse3200.game.areas.terrain.map

Class RoomTransition

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.areas.terrain.map.RoomTransition
public class RoomTransition extends Object
Describes a doorway in a level map and where it sends the player.

The doorway position and size are measured in tiles. The destination spawn is also a tile coordinate, but belongs to the destination map. Keeping this data in the map file means final doorway artwork and room layouts can be changed without changing transition code.
